def factor_tail_stress_underwater_active_mean(df):
    """Volume-confirmed downside stress while underwater, averaged over active underwater days."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    volume = df_copy['volume']
    daily_ret = close.pct_change()
    downside_move = (-daily_ret).clip(lower=0.0)
    rolling_high = close.rolling(63, min_periods=10).max()
    underwater = close < rolling_high
    volume_ratio = volume / volume.rolling(60, min_periods=10).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stress = downside_move * volume_ratio.clip(upper=3.0)
    stress = stress.where(underwater, 0.0)
    stress_sum = stress.rolling(21, min_periods=5).sum()
    underwater_count = underwater.astype(float).rolling(21, min_periods=5).sum()
    factor = stress_sum / underwater_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return factor.rename('factor_tail_stress_underwater_active_mean')

Child normalizes the rolling sum by the number of active underwater days, producing a conditional average stress per underwater day. This preserves the strong RankICIR and payoff-related monotonicity of the parent set while targeting low IC/ICIR by reducing noise from unequal underwater-day counts.
